principle: A canonical surface may be sparse, but it must not be structurally blank before redesign begins.
rules: Use canonical acceptedKinds and allowedSelections to establish the framework before visual design.
An empty framework node remains an empty collection; do not invent filler content.
Framework completion does not prescribe layout or visual hierarchy.
Cross-surface references may populate a framework node without transferring canonical ownership.
Do not create new first-level navigation merely to make a sparse page look full.
